hook.rumour: On the wooden boardwalks of Gnaar Mok, net-fishers whisper that an Imperial revenue cutter vanished in the fog off Khartag Point while bribed excise clerks look the other way.
hook.notice: COASTAL EXCISE NOTICE AT GNAAR MOK — Reward offered for locating the missing revenue cutter crew and auditing the smuggler coves between Gnaar Mok and Zainsipilu.
hook.context: In the Bitter Coast's mosquito-ridden mangroves, every hollow stump and sea-grotto hides moon-sugar or Dwemer brass, and half the customs patrols are on the smugglers' payroll.

stages.objective: Question the net-fishers on the stilt-piers of Gnaar Mok about the missing revenue cutter
Search the rocky headland at Khartag Point for the cutter's shattered lantern-box
Inspect the coastal watch-platform at Dubdil Alar Tower for signal-ash

objectives.text: Question the net-fishers on the stilt-piers of Gnaar Mok about the missing revenue cutter
Search the rocky headland at Khartag Point for the cutter's shattered lantern-box
Inspect the coastal watch-platform at Dubdil Alar Tower for signal-ash

consequence_detail.summary: The shattered lantern-box at Khartag Point proves the revenue cutter was lured into the sea-caves of Nammu and Mannammu by a bribed clerk.

stages.objective: Clear the smuggler lookouts inside the sea-caverns of Nammu and free the captive oarsmen
Seize the bribed customs-cipher book from the tide-cache at Mannammu
Track the syndicate's quartermaster to the mangrove grotto of Zainsipilu

objectives.text: Clear the smuggler lookouts inside the sea-caverns of Nammu and free the captive oarsmen
Seize the bribed customs-cipher book from the tide-cache at Mannammu
Track the syndicate's quartermaster to the mangrove grotto of Zainsipilu

consequence_detail.summary: The captive revenue oarsmen are freed from Nammu, and the cipher book reveals the corrupt excise chief hides at Ashalmimilkala.

stages.objective: Storm the Daedric mire-ruin of Ashalmimilkala and defeat the corrupt excise-master's guard
Recover the Imperial Excise Brass Seal from the flooded vaults of Ashurnibibi
Burn the contraband moon-sugar depot hidden inside Ulummusa

objectives.text: Storm the Daedric mire-ruin of Ashalmimilkala and defeat the corrupt excise-master's guard
Recover the Imperial Excise Brass Seal from the flooded vaults of Ashurnibibi
Burn the contraband moon-sugar depot hidden inside Ulummusa

consequence_detail.summary: The corrupt excise-master's ring is broken at Ashalmimilkala and the Imperial Excise Brass Seal is recovered.

stages.objective: Relight the true coast-lantern atop Khartag Point
Return the Imperial Excise Brass Seal to the freed cutter captain at Gnaar Mok
Accept the gratitude of Gnaar Mok's fishers on the boardwalk pier

objectives.text: Relight the true coast-lantern atop Khartag Point
Return the Imperial Excise Brass Seal to the freed cutter captain at Gnaar Mok
Accept the gratitude of Gnaar Mok's fishers on the boardwalk pier

consequence_detail.summary: The Khartag Point beacon shines clearly through the marsh fog and Gnaar Mok's fishers trade free of corrupt shakedowns.
